name: Taiwan
description: Taiwan from its Austronesian peoples to Dutch and Qing rule, Japanese rule, the Republic of China, martial law, democracy and chips.

checkpoints.name: The island and its peoples
checkpoints.note: Austronesian peoples lived on the island for thousands of years, in villages of the plains and the mountains.

checkpoints.name: Colonies and empire
checkpoints.note: The Dutch held the south until Koxinga drove them out in 1662. The Qing ruled for two centuries while Chinese farmers settled the west, and Japan ruled the island from 1895 to 1945.

checkpoints.name: The Republic of China
checkpoints.note: The Nationalists took over in 1945, crushed the uprising of 1947 and moved their government to Taipei in 1949. Chiang ruled under martial law while factories grew.

checkpoints.name: Democracy
checkpoints.note: Martial law ended in 1987 and the first free presidential vote came in 1996. Taiwan became a democracy and the maker of the world's most advanced chips, under constant pressure from Beijing.
